summary: No confirmed Critical or Important defects in the requested integrated patches. One reproduced Minor particle-culling defect.

minor.title: Uploaded particle motion leaves the cached bounding sphere stale
minor.impact: Near a viewport edge, Three.js can cull the whole eruption layer while updated particles are inside the frustum. This is a latent culling weakness made visible by the repaired shared particle buffer; it does not invalidate the alpha-zero or upload repair.
minor.repro: Create the real eruption layer at radius 0.00465; compute its initial boundingSphere as the renderer does; run the real blend updater with a normalized feature arc at 3 solar radii and alpha=0. Clip to x >= 2 solar radii. The first updated particle is inside this frustum, but Frustum.intersectsObject(layer) is false because the sphere still encloses the initial positions and layer.frustumCulled remains true.
minor.recommendation: Recompute or conservatively maintain the particle bounding sphere after position updates, including base-radius changes; alternatively disable frustum culling for this small dynamic layer, as other solar lines already do.

verified_contracts.time: Independent pinned-Python probes covered all 27 active positive-leap boundaries: ordinary UTC-origin and independent TAI-origin midnights survive TwoPartJD; final genuine leap fractions are rejected as UnsupportedUTCInstant; scalar bins at both leap edges reject as AmbiguousScalarJD. Both components remain distinct cache-key inputs; mixed precise/scalar aliases reject. HTTP pair completeness, finiteness, precise bounds and 400/422 mapping were read against the integrated source and existing ingress tests.
verified_contracts.observed_solar: The public parser selects the bounded correction only for the pinned compressed identity plus the actual expanded FITS hash. The PFSS consumer reparses native bytes and compares field, grid, full identity and provenance. Independent probes accepted the retained authentic map and rejected forged compressed hash, source URL, native bytes and correction metadata. Both polarities, <=5% imbalance and the original post-correction roundoff limit remain required; no condition-number or physical acceptance threshold was weakened.
verified_contracts.hale: Independently ran 12 absolute-polarity/map-footpoint cases for both hemispheres in cycles 24/25/26 and the snapshot/cache identity regression. Synthetic transform v4 and model v5 separate the repaired polarity from old cache content. Cached prior evidence was inspected; the primary NASA manuscript was also independently opened and checked.
verified_contracts.particles: Independent pinned-Node probes confirmed the actual BufferAttribute shares the animator Float32Array; alpha 0 selects the source, 1 selects the target, finite out-of-range values clamp, nonfinite values select the target, and the midpoint follows the spherical arc. Eight actual geometry cases passed.
verified_contracts.client: Independent pinned-Node probes confirmed legacy replacements use a new socket both with and without explicit deactivation, delayed old-socket callbacks cannot update state, and legacy commands remain untagged. Modern old-subscription frames continue updating ordinary bodies while preserving the accepted replacement Kuiper snapshot.
